# annotation-cli

> Label model outputs in the terminal with single-key choices, undo, resumable append-only JSONL storage, safe display of untrusted text and Cohen's kappa agreement Python package `trysac-annotation-cli`, import name `annotation_cli`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
